metadata.methods_description: ERP data were collected at the NeuroCognition Laboratory at San Diego State University. Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room and viewed a 24-inch LCD monitor at 152 cm viewing distance. Stimuli consisted of 90 four-letter real words and 90 four-letter pseudowords presented in three flanker conditions (no flanker, identical flankers, different flankers) for a total of 270 trials. Each trial included a 1000ms purple fixation cross, 500ms white fixation cross, 150ms stimulus presentation, and response window. Participants responded via game controller.
